# `schema_of_avro`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
schema_of_avro(jsonFormatSchema, options)
```

Returns schema in the DDL format of the avro schema in JSON string format.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Not implemented yet |
| Group | `avro_funcs` |
| Kind | unknown (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.0 and later |
| Arguments | [1, 2] |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT schema_of_avro('{"type": "record", "name": "struct", "fields": [{"name": "u", "type": ["int", "string"]}]}', map());
```

Result:

```text
STRUCT<u: STRUCT<member0: INT, member1: STRING> NOT NULL>
```
